summary: [para 25] 25. The Petitioner has submitted an RCE for the transmission project totalling ₹8791.00 lakh, which was accorded approval by the Committee on Investment on Projects at its 129 th meeting held on 27.03.2022, wherein the Revised Cost Estimate (RCE) of the project is approved as ₹8791.00 lakh. The Petitioner has since reapportioned the capital cost among individual assets based on this RCE, and the individual costs are confirmed to be within the total approved RCE cost. [para 40] 40. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner and have gone through the documents placed on record. It is noted that the Plant and Machinery cost in the Auditor’s Certificate does not match the cost in Form-13. Accordingly, the Petitioner is directed to submit a revised Initial Spare claim clearly mentioning the Plant and Machinery cost, excluding IDC, IEDC, land cost and cost of civil works, which also matches the figures in Form-13. Further, the Petitioner is directed to submit a reconciled Form-5 at the time of true-up. [para 41] 41. We have provisionally considered the Plant and Machinery cost as per the Auditor’s Certificate for the purpose of determining the Initial Spares for the instant transmission project. The Petitioner has not claimed any Initial Spares for Asset-I to Asset-IV, these were incorrectly incorporated in Form-5 for those assets. Accordingly, we have provisionally considered the capital costs claimed by the Petitioner for Assets I to IV. The Petitioner is directed to submit the correct Initial Spares details along with [para 50] 50. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions. The ACE claimed by the Petitioner has been allowed under Regulation 24(1)(a) and 24(1)(b) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations on account of the undischarged liabilities recognised to be payable at a future date and works deferred for execution. Accordingly, the ACE allowed for the 2019-24 period is as follows: [¶] Company. Accordingly, the applicable MAT rate has been considered for RoE purposes, which shall be trued-up with the actual tax rate in accordance with Regulation 31(3) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. The RoE has been worked out and allowed with respect to the transmission assets for the 2019-24 tariff period is as follows: [para 60] 60. The Petitioner has not claimed O&M Expenses for Asset-I, Asset-II, Asset-III, Asset-IV, Asset-V, Asset-VII. The Petitioner has claimed O&M Expenses for Asset-VI, Asset-VIII and Asset-IX. Accordingly, the O&M Expenses claimed by the Petitioner for the transmission assets for the 2019-24 period are as under: [para 80] 80. We have considered the Petitioner's submissions. Since we have determined the transmission tariff with respect to the transmission assets in this order, the prayer for an interim tariff becomes redundant. [¶] a.
